Lunch is excluded and the later Lake Louise or Banff sightseeing is optional. Keep the riding session as the reason for choosing the outing. sections.title: Choose the actual seasonal itinerary
paragraphs: The description limits Moraine Lake visits to June 1 through October 12 and substitutes attractions from October 13 through May 31. That qualification matters more than the product name. Check the dated route and access before choosing a winter or shoulder-season departure for Moraine Lake.

Johnston Canyon appears as an optional itinerary item. Do not assume every booking combines two lakes and the canyon. Ask which stops apply to your departure and whether the advertised lake time remains the plan. A seasonal substitution changes what you will see.

Use the precise meeting point attached to your Banff or Canmore selection. Included transfers start at designated points, so plan the hotel connection yourself. Meals and tips are excluded. Confirm the return location and timing before arranging an evening reservation or another fixed departure.

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: Skates fitted at the lake listed

sections.title: Check the fit and skating format
paragraphs: The published skate range runs from youth size 1 to men’s 13. Contact the provider about anyone outside that range and confirm the sizing system. Thick socks are requested. Personal winter clothing is excluded, so equipment fitting does not replace preparation for time outside.

A guide accompanies the visit, but instruction is explicitly excluded. Consider the least confident skater in your party. The page sets a minimum age of six, requires an accompanying adult for guests fifteen or under, and describes guardian signatures for under-eighteens. Confirm your participants’ arrangements.

sections.title: Treat the date and ice as conditional
paragraphs: The provider describes contacting guests if the surface is closed or unsuitable, with refund or rescheduling choices, and says it does not operate below minus 25 degrees Celsius. Read your selected booking’s terms. A reservation does not establish current ice condition or permission to skate elsewhere.

The itinerary presents Banff and Canmore meeting points and roughly two hours at the lake within a four-hour outing. Confirm pickup and return. Group-size wording conflicts between highlights and inclusions, so ask about actual capacity. Food, drinks, tips and personal winter clothing are separate.
